### 2026-10-07 — **kicad humbled me. (starbie day 1)**

**4h**

**kicad humbled me. (starbie day 1)**

So hi there, today im starting to build Half life's very own starbie! (using a xiao esp32 c3, OLED, 2 buttons, MPU6050, and DHT11).

For context, I have never used kicad or any other type of software for PCBs. The goal for this session was to get the schematic done, I estimated this would take like 2 hours max, but it took me 4 hours and I'm not even completely finished.

the first hour was mostly just figuring out and installing kicad. I read the week 1 guide and saw a lot of things I've never seen before. I managed to install kicad and the care package(thank you very much)  but that's as far as I got without google. The guide said to search up how to install them and I had to learn the differences between system libraries and footprint ones(which are very pretty...).

![01-start-xiao-c3-placed](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tMjn9vs6h4UtlNzH7FQFJKV4hMCwzrGf/4bec51e9fe9b10d2e2ebc2dc83893dad02cd33fd88babc879a7812563fb1969a.png)

alright, so the next thing in this session was using the wrong chip for a large majority of the wiring. basically I searched Xiao and ended up with the S3 version of the chip instead of the C3. I went on and labeled everything and stuff,  until i got to the part where I had to cross out the rest of the pins, where I realized I had some extra ones for USB, so I had to start over and lose another hour worth of work.

I also noticed that the guide had a inconstancy cus i got bored while wiring it up and decided to look all around the files and folders and the code to see how it worked, and by some miraculous sight I saw that the d4 and d5 pins on the board were reversed in the code. Im not sure what's the right one 100% but ima stick with the code. after that, i fully wired up the board.

![02-xiao-wired](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tMjn9vs6h4UtlNzH7FQFJKV4hMCwzrGf/7be932ab9c9f0a0c66ccc9e7716112d2713f418a0b418c65d02fa95fcf461e3c.png)

after this, I wasted another lot of my time by misusing L and P.  So basically, I wired the ground buttons with L instead of P for like a lot of the things, so I had to delete and redo them all, and I learned my lesson.

![03-gnd-label-mistake](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tMjn9vs6h4UtlNzH7FQFJKV4hMCwzrGf/e4b15be274485e2829d764892eeee8420e51b149dc5fb1a91772fcb64f6490f6.png)

(^mistake one)

![04-gnd-fixed-power-symbol](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tMjn9vs6h4UtlNzH7FQFJKV4hMCwzrGf/c83d94670769256513b3c58b3b024585964e7119c4d8cb7df47ac72ab0d809aa.png)

(^fixed one)

for the OLED, MPU6050, and DHT11, it went pretty smoothly, however I accidently jumped the gun on the footprint editor and hit a few buttons and had to figure out how to get out and undo what i just did.

![06-erc-errors](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tMjn9vs6h4UtlNzH7FQFJKV4hMCwzrGf/8f8b6759dc4b74be3cd0e6546ae3e1bdd492ece2a3139be54e830bfc463383eb.png)

![05-oled-mpu-wired](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tMjn9vs6h4UtlNzH7FQFJKV4hMCwzrGf/1629489ae4559a040aab6aaf5fa451ddc7648a2393a5779e07d13fad39c6d82d.png)

For the last part  of this session I used ERC. firstly it took me a while and some searhing to even find it on the tool bar(my window was sized incorreclty), then I got 3 errors about "Input Power pin not driven by any Output Power pins" and learned I have to use power flags to fix it, which I'll do next time.

anyways, I need to study, this took up way more time then I thought it would.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tMjn9vs6h4UtlNzH7FQFJKV4hMCwzrGf/547209e346b0ea431ad8d5e068bbf493e30b4e48cbda32bdbbf59425b05fe57b.png)

idk if half life has an AI disclosure rule but I did use claude as a tutor and to troubleshoot errors.

See you next time, Ziyaad

*tl;dr: first time ever in KiCad, 4 hours, wired the whole Starbie schematic, messed up constantly (wrong chip, L vs P, footprint rabbit hole), 3 ERC errors left to fix.*
